plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Anthropology (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] No anthropology course will satisfy this requirement.
[grid1 fn3] These courses fulfill the prerequisites for STAT 302 or STAT 303
[grid1 fn4] Select from ANTH 200-499. Up to 6 hours from ANTH 200-299, 6 to 12 hours may be selected from ANTH 300-499.
[grid1 fn5] See departmental advisor for list of additional science courses.
[grid1 fn6] These courses have a Field or Lab experiential component
